title: Universal property of the unsharpened spectrum of a fine monoid
statement:
Let $P$ be a fine integral commutative monoid and let $T$ be a topological space with a sheaf $\mathcal A$ of commutative monoids. Use monoid spectra, their ordinary structure sheaves, germs and local homomorphisms as in [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Write $A(P)=(\operatorname{Spec}_{\mathrm{mon}}P,\widetilde P)$. A local morphism $(T,\mathcal A)\to A(P)$ consists of a continuous map $h$ and a restriction-compatible family of homomorphisms $\widetilde P(U)\to\mathcal A(h^{-1}U)$ on opens $U$, such that each stalk homomorphism is local. Pullback of the canonical sections gives a natural bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{loc.mon.sp}}((T,\mathcal A),A(P))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Mon}}(P,\Gamma(T,\mathcal A)).$$
It is natural in $(T,\mathcal A)$ and in $P$. For a homomorphism $\rho:P\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal A)$ the corresponding morphism sends $t\in T$ to $\mathfrak p_t=\{p\in P:\rho(p)_t\notin\mathcal A_t^\times\}$; its stalk homomorphism is $P_{\mathfrak p_t}\to\mathcal A_t$, $p-f\mapsto\rho(p)_t-\rho(f)_t$, for $f\notin\mathfrak p_t$, where subtraction means addition of the inverse of the indicated unit. No sharpness or torsion-freeness assumption is made.

proof.text: For a prime x, evaluate each local-fraction section on a neighborhood of x at x in the face localization L=P[(P\x)^(-1)]. These evaluations commute with restriction and give a map to the skyscraper sheaf with value L at x. Extend across the sheafification unit by its universal property, then take the colimit over neighborhoods. The resulting stalk-to-L homomorphism sends the canonical germ of p to the numerator p/1. This uses the actual section and germ definitions of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] and the unsharpened affine model of [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization].

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(i), printed p.99 (ordinary structure sheaf, not the sharp version 3.1.8(ii)); conventions 3.1.3, 3.1.5--3.1.6. No Stacks tag states this monoidal-space result.

proof.text: If the germ of p is a unit, its image p/1 in L is a unit. Represent its inverse by q/f. Then p*q=f in the group completion, hence in P by injectivity. The prime complement is a submonoid, so its closure still avoids x; f is outside x. The ideal property implies p is outside x. Conversely, for p outside x the germ of the section 1/p is an inverse of the numerator germ: their product equals 1 already in the local-fraction presheaf, hence in its sheafification and stalk. Thus a numerator germ is a unit exactly outside x. Finite generation and the minimum-neighborhood lemma are unnecessary for this argument.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(i), printed p.99 (ordinary structure sheaf, not the sharp version 3.1.8(ii)); conventions 3.1.3, 3.1.5--3.1.6. No Stacks tag states this monoidal-space result.

proof.text: Germ-pullback compatibility follows from the colimit defining stalkMap. Thus the stalk map of f sends each numerator germ to the germ of rho(p). Locality reflects units, and Step 3 identifies the prime of f(t) with the elements whose rho-germs are nonunits. For a outside that prime, the product of the germ of p/a with the numerator germ of a is the numerator germ of p; prove this in the local-fraction presheaf and apply sheafification and germs. Apply the stalk map and the numerator compatibility. Multiplication by the inverse of the specified unit v gives the fraction formula, without cancellation or integrality assumptions on the target stalk.

lean.statement: theorem spectrum_hom_universal (P : Type u) [CommMonoid P] (hP : FineFan.IsFine P) : (∀ T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}, Function.Bijective (fun f : {f : T ⟶ affine P // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism f} ↦ (SheafedSpace.Γ.map f.val.op).hom.comp (affineSection P))) ∧ (∀ (T T' : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}) (k : {k : T' ⟶ T // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism k}) (f : {f : T ⟶ affine P // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism f}), (SheafedSpace.Γ.map (k.val ≫ f.val).op).hom.comp (affineSection P) = (SheafedSpace.Γ.map k.val.op).hom.comp ((SheafedSpace.Γ.map f.val.op).hom.comp (affineSection P))) ∧ (∀ (Q : Type u) [CommMonoid Q], FineFan.IsFine Q → ∀ w : P →* Q, ∃! g : {g : affine Q ⟶ affine P // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism g}, (SheafedSpace.Γ.map g.val.op).hom.comp (affineSection P) = (affineSection Q).comp w ∧ ∀ (T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}) (f : {f : T ⟶ affine Q // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism f}), (SheafedSpace.Γ.map (f.val ≫ g.val).op).hom.comp (affineSection P) = ((SheafedSpace.Γ.map f.val.op).hom.comp (affineSection Q)).comp w) ∧ (∀ (T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}) (ρ : P →* T.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (f : {f : T ⟶ affine P // FineFan.IsLocalMorphism f}), (SheafedSpace.Γ.map f.val.op).hom.comp (affineSection P) = ρ → (∀ (t : T) (p : P), p ∈ (f.val.hom.base t).carrier ↔ ¬ IsUnit (FineFan.germ T.presheaf ⊤ t (by trivial) (ρ p))) ∧ (∀ (t : T) (p a : P) (ha : a ∉ (f.val.hom.base t).carrier) (v : (FineFan.stalk T.presheaf t)ˣ), (v : FineFan.stalk T.presheaf t) = FineFan.germ T.presheaf ⊤ t (by trivial) (ρ a) → FineFan.stalkMap f.val t (fractionGerm (f.val.hom.base t) p a ha) = FineFan.germ T.presheaf ⊤ t (by trivial) (ρ p) * ((v⁻¹ : (FineFan.stalk T.presheaf t)ˣ) : FineFan.stalk T.presheaf t)))
